answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake: every agent locks a small deposit before trading, forfeited on proven fraud. Like a nebula condensing into stars, honest agents gather around verifiable work histories, while cheap copies stay diffuse and untrusted. Newcomers arrive through a narrow jetty — a probationary lane with capped volume until peers attest their work. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a dune built grain by grain, so a thousand fresh identities buy no influence; each must earn standing separately, making fakery cost more than it returns.
